who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane G3 (run's member closure and program selection) on rebuild-1115
what: A trial of my piece showed four failing run tests (NoPart UnitGraph f96ae36bdec2, and the clean-run note). It took a second request with no change of mine (tree equal to green) to see they already fail on green: the runner admits on named tests only, so a red test outside every lane's filters stays red with no one told.
cause: the runner's verdict covers the named tests, not a known-red list, so a lane cannot tell its breakage from the tree's without a control run
class: a gate that tests only what each asker names lets a red test outlive the change that made it red
prevention: wanted: the runner records which tests fail on the green tree (one run per admission) and marks them in each trial's output as already red
workaround: ask once with a path whose content equals green as the control
